pages.text:
Twisted-pair Cable
Pairs of conductors are twisted to improve electromagnetic compatibility
32DSI102 · Introduction to Digital Technology · Week 5
WHY IT WORKS
1 Positions alternate
Each conductor repeatedly moves 
closer to—and farther from—noise 
sources.
2 Noise becomes common
Interference is induced similarly in 
both wires instead of mainly in one.
3 The receiver subtracts
Common noise cancels, leaving the 
intended difference signal clearer.
Twisting keeps both wires equally exposed to interference.
pages.title: Twisted-pair Cable

Key Takeaways
The core ideas to remember
• Networks connect devices through links.
• Devices have different roles: repeat, switch, route, access, protect.
• Links may be copper, fiber, or wireless.
• Network type depends on scale and purpose.
• Topology describes how nodes and links are arranged.
